resources.string: A small pet lives on your screen and keeps an eye on your screen time.
It nudges you when you go past your limits, and cheers when you take a break or finish a focus session.
Which apps you use never leaves this phone.
Nyx is made for people aged 18 and over, so setup can\'t continue.
Nyx needs a few things from your phone. Each one opens the right settings screen. You can skip any of them and come back later.
Lets Nyx see which app is open and for how long. Find Nyx in the list and turn it on.
The pet can\'t see your apps, so it can\'t track your time or react to it.
Lets the pet sit on top of other apps. Find Nyx in the list and turn it on.
The pet can\'t appear on your screen.
For break reminders, nags while the pet is hidden, and the note that shows the pet is running.
No break reminders or alerts outside the pet.
Makes it less likely that your phone stops the pet to save battery. In the list, show all apps, find Nyx and choose not to optimise it.
Your phone may stop the pet in the background.
Your phone may need a few more steps:
You can turn these on later from Settings.

string-array.name: battery_steps_xiaomi
string-array.item: Open Nyx\'s app settings below and turn on Autostart.
Under Battery saver, choose No restrictions.
In your recent apps, lock Nyx so it isn\'t cleared.

string-array.name: battery_steps_samsung
string-array.item: Open Nyx\'s app settings below, tap Battery and choose Unrestricted.
In your phone\'s battery settings, make sure Nyx isn\'t listed as a sleeping or deep sleeping app.

string-array.name: battery_steps_vivo
string-array.item: Open Nyx\'s app settings below and allow Autostart if you see it.
Under Battery, allow high background power use.
In your recent apps, lock Nyx so it isn\'t cleared.

string-array.name: battery_steps_oppo
string-array.item: Open Nyx\'s app settings below and allow Auto launch if you see it.
Under Battery usage, allow background activity.
In your recent apps, lock Nyx so it isn\'t cleared.

string-array.name: battery_steps_other
string-array.item: If the pet ever disappears on its own, open Nyx\'s app settings below and look for battery or background options that let Nyx keep running.

resources.string: Nyx has guessed a category for each app. Tap an app to fix any that are wrong.
The pet nudges you when you go past a limit. These are sensible starting points; change any you like.
Continuous use of %1$s. Screen off for a few minutes counts as a break.
You can share an anonymous summary once a day. It helps show whether Nyx actually helps people.
Minutes per category, focus sessions started and finished, nags, snoozes, breaks, whether the pet was running, and the app and Android versions, with a random ID that isn\'t linked to you.
Which apps you use, your name or accounts, your location, and anything that identifies you.
Off unless you turn it on. You can change this later in Settings.
The pet is hidden for now.
Nyx is keeping an eye on your screen time.
Tap to turn it back on.
